title: Eclectic flavour symmetries without flavons
summary: We develop a new framework in which eclectic groups are realised as flavour symmetries without flavons. Focusing on the group $Ω(1)$, we show that it can be realised as a finite image of the integral Jacobi group, i.e. the semidirect product of $H({\mathbb Z})$ with $SL(2,{\mathbb Z})$, acting on two moduli $(τ,z)$. The Heisenberg subgroup $H({\mathbb Z})$ leaves the modulus $τ$ unchanged, and its finite image $Δ(27)$ plays the role of the traditional flavour symmetry.
